integrity: The mathematical proofs and finite checks are presented without an authorship, outside certification, or independent-review claim.
scientific_limitations: All statements require synchronous binary self-inclusive (closed-neighborhood) NOR on rook graphs with both board dimensions at least two.
Fair independent initial bits are required for stated attraction probabilities and asymptotic laws.
Finite exhaustions corroborate but do not establish all-size theorems or asymptotic claims.

title: An anisotropic attraction-basin crossover for closed NOR on rook graphs
